newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong air cargo traffic falls in slack Feb.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong air cargo traffic falls in slack Feb.

text.p: The amount of air cargo imports and exports to and from Hong Kong during February showed a fall of more than 25,000 tonnes from the previous month, latest Civil Aviation Department statistics suggest.
South East Asia remained Hong Kong's biggest trading partner for imports but the U.S. and Canada gained top export destination with 9,769 tonnes flying trans-Pacific from Hong Kong.
The seasonal drop in tonnages is mainly attributed to Chinese New Year when factories in Hong Kong's hinterland shut down for up to two weeks holiday, industry observers said.
Compared to the same month last year, Hong Kong air cargo traffic recorded a 6.1 per cent increase with 51,036.4 of imports and 50,919.6 tonnes of exports.
